metadata.description: Azure region. Defaults to the resource group location.
Name of the Container App (and the prefix for its managed identity).
Resource id of an existing Container Apps managed environment to host the app.
Container image reference, e.g. myregistry.azurecr.io/sqlflow-slack-bot:latest
Name of an existing Key Vault holding the Slack and SQLFlow token secrets.
The model provider answering questions: AzureFoundry (managed identity, no key), OpenAI (platform API key), or Anthropic (Claude API key).
Key Vault secret name for the Slack app-level token (xapp-..., Socket Mode).
Key Vault secret name for the Slack bot user OAuth token (xoxb-...).
Key Vault secret name for the read-scoped SQLFlow personal access token the assistant presents to the MCP server.
Key Vault secret name for the provider API key. Read only when assistantProvider is OpenAI or Anthropic.
The Foundry project endpoint, e.g. https://<account>.services.ai.azure.com/api/projects/<project>. Required when assistantProvider is AzureFoundry.
The model deployment (in the same Foundry account) the assistant runs on. Required when assistantProvider is AzureFoundry.
The OpenAI model, which must support the Responses API with the hosted MCP tool. Used when assistantProvider is OpenAI.
The Claude model id. Used when assistantProvider is Anthropic.
The deployed SQLFlow MCP server endpoint the assistant uses as its tool source, e.g. https://sqlflow-mcp.<env-domain>/mcp.
SQLFlow GUI base URL; when set, answers link runs and pipelines to their GUI pages. Empty disables links.

Name of a container registry in THIS resource group: the template grants the app identity AcrPull on it and configures the pull. Leave empty for a public registry, or one you authorize yourself via acrLoginServer.
Login server of a registry outside this resource group (grant AcrPull to the app identity yourself). Ignored when acrName is set.
vCPU per replica; a relay with no local model work needs the smallest consumption pair.
Memory per replica, paired with cpu.

variables.apiKeySecrets: [if(variables('usesApiKey'), createArray(createObject('name', 'model-api-key', 'keyVaultUrl', format('{0}secrets/{1}', variables('vaultUri'), parameters('modelApiKeySecretName')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))), createArray())]

resources.name: [parameters('name')]

configuration.registries: [if(empty(if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer'))), createArray(), createArray(createObject('server', if(not(empty(parameters('acrName'))), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), '2023-07-01').loginServer, parameters('acrLoginServer')), 'identity', resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))))))]

containers.name: slack-bot
containers.env: [concat(variables('baseEnv'), if(equals(parameters('assistantProvider'), 'AzureFoundry'), createArray(createObject('name', 'SlackBot__Foundry__ProjectEndpoint', 'value', parameters('foundryProjectEndpoint')), createObject('name', 'SlackBot__Foundry__ModelDeploymentName', 'value', parameters('foundryModelDeploymentName')), createObject('name', 'AZURE_CLIENT_ID', 'value', reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), '2023-01-31').clientId)), createArray()), variables('openaiEnv'), variables('anthropicEnv'))]

dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/registries', if(empty(parameters('acrName')), 'unused', parameters('acrName'))), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceGroup().id, parameters('acrName'), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', format('{0}-id', parameters('name'))), variables('acrPullRoleId')))]

metadata.description: The principal (object) id of the bot identity: in AzureFoundry mode, grant it Foundry access (ai-foundry.bicep agentPrincipalIds).
The client id of the bot identity.
